integrity: Self-contained proof with independently reconstructed 28-vertex graph, exact algebraic checks, and a reproducible checker; no external mathematical audit or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: One fixed Coxeter graph only; root given by analytic equation; external equivalence search bounded. The checker verifies finite graph identities exactly but not uncountably many exponents, which are handled by analytic inequalities.
title: Sharp negative type and Gaussian positivity on the 28-vertex Coxeter graph
